events.name: The Coffee Trails
events.registration_notes: No registration page found. ITRA lists 18 Oct 2026; Ultra Race Calendar lists 8 Nov 2026. Confirm with organiser.
events.summary: Small-field mountain ultra through Coorg coffee estates, meadows and evergreen forest, capped at about 100 runners. Previous editions ran on 13 Oct 2024 and 9 Nov 2025.

categories.name: 62K
categories.notes: About 2,820 m gain, 4 aid stations (ITRA listing).

course.surface: estate tracks, meadow and forest single track with mud
course.description: Coffee estates, grassland and evergreen mountain forest around Madikeri; organisers warn of rain, climbing, mud and slush.

tips: Expect mud and slush even after the monsoon; use grippy trail shoes.
Madikeri is about 120 km from Mysuru by road; stay in Madikeri the night before.
Date conflict between listings; verify before booking travel.

events.name: Jawadhu Hills Ultra
events.venue: St. Joseph Higher Secondary School, Jamunamarathur, Jawadhu Hills
events.registration_notes: Closed after the 400-slot cap filled. Fees not shown.
events.summary: Trail ultra in the Jawadhu Hills of Tamil Nadu, roughly equidistant from Bengaluru and Chennai. Part of the South India Trail Grail circuit with 30K, 60K and 100K options.

categories.name: 30K
categories.eligibility: JHU 2024/2025 participant, or half marathon under 3 hours in 2026, or 20K+ trail finish in 2026
categories.notes: About 700-900 m gain. Waves 10 minutes apart; report 5:30 AM.

categories.name: 60K
categories.eligibility: JHU 60K/50K finisher, or marathon under 5:30 in 2026, or 30K+ trail finish, or 50K stadium run within 7 hours in 2026
categories.notes: About 1300-1600 m gain. Point-to-point to Titanur Temple. Cutoff 27.5 km at 5:30 hours.

categories.name: 100K
categories.eligibility: JHU 60K/50K finisher, or two sub-5:30 marathons in 2026, or 50K+ trail finish, or 75K stadium run in 2026
categories.notes: About 2500 m gain. Cutoffs: 60 km at 12 hours, 75 km at 15 hours.

course.description: Hill trails around Jamunamarathur; 30K and 100K loop back to the school, 60K ends at Titanur Temple. Elevation is for the 100K.

highlights: Free camping at the school venue
tips: Torch or headlamp is mandatory for 60K and 100K; barefoot running is not allowed.
Buses between Alangayam and Polur pass Jamunamarathur about every 45 minutes; the last runs around 7:30 PM.
Vellore is about 90 km away via Alangayam; Bengaluru runners usually drive via Vaniyambadi.
Carry ID, running shoes and a hydration bottle or bladder to bib collection; kit is checked.

events.name: Kaveri Trail Marathon
events.venue: Near Ranganathittu Bird Sanctuary (canal entrance), Srirangapatna
events.registration_notes: NEB Sports lists registration as closed. Fees below are standard prices from a third-party guide; early offers were lower.
events.summary: India's longest-running trail marathon, started in 2007, on canal-side paths beside the Kaveri near Srirangapatna. Flat and fast for a trail race.

categories.name: Full Marathon
categories.notes: First loop must be done within 3 hours.

categories.name: 5K Fun Run
categories.notes: Flat course; children 6-12 may run with a registered adult in the same category.

course.surface: packed earth canal path with some grass
course.description: Out-and-back canal-side loop of about 10.55 km; four loops for the full and two for the half, per race guide.

highlights: Flat trail suited to first-time trail runners
tips: Watch for tree roots and narrow, uneven sections on the canal path; light trail shoes are enough.
Srirangapatna is a short drive from Mysuru; Bengaluru runners usually stay overnight in Mysuru or Srirangapatna.
Full marathoners must finish the first loop inside 3 hours.

events.name: Khadakwasla Ultra
events.venue: Krushnai Water Park & Resort, Donje, near Khadakwasla Dam
events.registration_notes: No deadline listed; fees not shown on the site.
events.summary: Road-based ultra on Pune's outskirts looping the Khadakwasla, Panshet and Varasgaon dam backwaters, from 25K up to 100K. Named best-rated ultra event of 2025 on its site.

categories.name: 35K The Bridge to Ultras
categories.notes: Out-and-back near Sinhagad toward Panshet.

categories.name: 55K The Road Ultra
categories.notes: Loop around Khadakwasla Dam.

categories.name: 75K The Endurance Builder
categories.notes: Adds Varasgaon backwaters.

categories.name: 100K The Ultimate Test
categories.notes: Includes Varasgaon and Panshet backwaters.

course.surface: mostly tarmac with short trail sections
course.description: Rolling rural roads and forest roads around three dam backwaters below the Sahyadris; elevation profiles to be shared before race day.

highlights: Distances from 25K to 100K in one event
tips: Headlamp is compulsory for early starters; a hydration bottle or vest, basic first aid and a phone are also mandatory.
The venue is about 30 minutes from Pune railway station by taxi; there is no published shuttle.
Long exposed road stretches heat up by late morning; plan sun protection.

events.name: The Malnad Ultra
events.venue: Start area at Mallanduru, Chikkamagaluru district (bib collection at The Estate Cafe)
events.registration_notes: Only the 100K is still open; 30K, 50K Day and 50K Night are closed. Eligibility proof due by 7 Nov 2026. Fees not published on the site.
events.summary: One of South India's best-known trail ultras, run on coffee-estate trails in the Malnad hills. ITRA-rated, a Western States qualifier and part of the South India Trail Grail circuit.

categories.name: 30K
categories.eligibility: Previous Malnad Ultra starter, or half marathon under 2:30 in 2026, or ITRA Performance Index above 0
categories.notes: +951 m. Single loop.

categories.name: 50K Day
categories.eligibility: Previous Malnad finisher, or full marathon under 5:30 in 2026, or ITRA PI above 275, or a 30K+ trail finish or 50K+ stadium run in 2026
categories.notes: +1705 m. Intermediate cutoff at AS5 (38 km) by 3:00 PM.

categories.name: 50K Night
categories.notes: +1705 m. Headlamp mandatory from the start. AS5 cutoff 1:30 AM.

categories.name: 100K
categories.eligibility: Previous 50K+ finisher, or two sub-5:30 marathons in 2026, or ITRA PI above 375, or a 50K+ trail finish or 75K+ stadium run in 2026
categories.notes: +3410 m, two 50 km loops. Race schedule table says 6:00 AM start; must start loop 2 by 4:30 PM.

course.surface: estate roads, walking paths and single track, with short tarmac and boulder sections; over 90% trail
course.description: 50 km clockwise loop through coffee estates near wildlife reserves with stream crossings; the 100K runs it twice. Elevation figure is per 50 km loop.

highlights: ITRA points and UTMB Index race
tips: Leeches are common in wet conditions; carry salt or leech socks.
Nearest stations are Birur and Kadur, about 1.5 hours away; from Bengaluru it is about 260 km (5 hours) by road.
Book a homestay early; more than 100 lie within 10 km but most rooms are dorm-style.
A personal headlamp is mandatory for night and 100K runners; phones and shared lights are not accepted.

events.name: Mussoorie Ultra
events.venue: The Fern Brentwood Resort, Mussoorie (race base)
events.registration_notes: Registration via District.in link on the official site; fees, cutoffs and start times not published on the home page.
events.summary: Hill ultra and running festival in Mussoorie above Dehradun, in its second edition, with a 50K ultra down to a 5K and a fun run.

categories.name: Half Marathon
categories.notes: Hill course at about 2,000 m.

course.description: Hill course around Mussoorie; route, surface and elevation not yet published.

highlights: Bib expo and musical evening on 28 Nov at the race base
tips: Late-November mornings in Mussoorie can be near freezing; bring gloves and a warm layer for the start.
Dehradun to Mussoorie is about 35 km of winding hill road; stay in Mussoorie the night before.
Collect your bib at the 28 Nov expo at The Fern Brentwood Resort.

events.name: Dudhsagar Ultra Trail
events.venue: Collem (Kolem), Mollem National Park and Bhagwan Mahaveer Wildlife Sanctuary
events.registration_notes: No organiser site found; details come from ITRA race listings, which could not be rendered for direct checking.
events.summary: Trail ultra in the forests around Dudhsagar falls in east Goa, listed on ITRA with 21K, 50K and 100K races and run since at least 2024.

categories.name: 100K
categories.notes: Field of about 150.

course.description: Trails through Mollem National Park and the Bhagwan Mahaveer Wildlife Sanctuary near Collem.

tips: Collem railway station is next to the start area; trains from Madgaon take about an hour.
Early December is dry but humid in the forest; plan for heat after mid-morning.
Verify the date with the organiser before travelling; details are from ITRA listings only.

events.name: Ultribe Paderu
events.venue: Paderu, Alluri Sitharama Raju district (Eastern Ghats)
events.registration_notes: Official page says 'stay tuned'. Distances from a third-party calendar; not yet published officially.
events.summary: Eastern Ghats trail ultra in the Paderu hills inland from Visakhapatnam, billed by its organisers as the longest race in South India and part of the South India Trail Grail circuit.

course.description: Hill trails in the Eastern Ghats around Paderu; route not yet published.

highlights: Organised by Vizag's trail running association
tips: Paderu is a winding ghat-road drive from Visakhapatnam; arrive the day before.
December nights in the Paderu hills are cold; pack a warm layer for a pre-dawn start.

events.name: SRT Ultra (Sinhagad-Rajgad-Torna)
events.registration_notes: Ticket sales window listed as 15 Aug to 30 Sep; prices include taxes. All runners must be 18 by 12 Dec 2026.
events.summary: Tough Sahyadri mountain ultra linking the Sinhagad, Rajgad and Torna forts south-west of Pune. Part of the South India Trail Grail circuit; proceeds support forest and archaeology conservation.

categories.name: 11K
categories.notes: +700 m. No transport back for 11K runners.

categories.name: 25K
categories.eligibility: Half marathon finish on or before 15 Nov 2026
categories.notes: +1100 m. Finishes at Gunjavane.

categories.name: 53K
categories.eligibility: Full marathon or 50K+ ultra finish on or before 15 Nov 2026
categories.notes: +2400 m. Cutoffs: 25 km by 11:30 AM, 34 km by 2:00 PM. Finishes at Velhe.

categories.name: 100K
categories.eligibility: Full marathon or 50K+ ultra finish on or before 15 Nov 2026
categories.notes: +3870 m. Cutoffs: 25 km 11:30 AM, 34 km 2:00 PM, 53 km 6:00 PM, 65 km 9:00 PM, 74 km midnight.

course.surface: rocky fort trails, ridgelines and village paths
course.description: Point-to-point fort traverse from the Sinhagad base over the Rajgad and Torna region; elevation figure is for the 100K.

tips: Semi-supported: carry at least 1 L of water and some food.
Free shuttles return 25K runners from Gunjavane and 53K/100K runners from Velhe to the start; 11K runners get no transport.
December days on the exposed ridges get hot by noon; protect against sun.
Previous SRT Ultra or Sinhagad Epic Trail timings count for eligibility.

events.name: Vagamon ULtrail
events.venue: St. Thomas LP School, Pullikanam, Vagamon (start/finish)
events.registration_notes: 300 slots (180 for 30K, 120 for 10K walk); closes when full. Fees not shown on the site. Signed waiver required.
events.summary: Hill trail race in the tea estates of Vagamon on the Kottayam-Idukki border, about 100 km from Kochi. For 2027 the 50K+ categories have been dropped, leaving a 30K run and a 10K trail walk.

categories.name: 30K Trail Run
categories.notes: Stage cutoff at about 24 km: leave before 2:00 PM. Age 18 as of 1 Jan 2027.

categories.name: 10K Trail Walk
categories.notes: Untimed walk on the Pullikanam Estate loop; under-18s need a parent or guardian.

course.surface: tea estate paths, mud and single track
course.description: Routes through tea estates, slush and single-path trails, crossing Forest Department land.

highlights: Tea-estate trails in the Western Ghats
tips: Hydration pack or 1.5 L bottle is mandatory and checked at the start.
The course is not barefoot-friendly; minimalist trail shoes have worked for past runners.
Travel package (Rs 2,100) runs an AC coach from Pathadipalam, Kochi on 8 Jan at 3 PM and back on 10 Jan.
Kottayam is the nearest railway station, but the shuttle only picks up in Kochi.

events.name: Deccan Ultra
events.venue: Bhandardara, Ahmednagar district (race base; 35K starts at Waki Dam)
events.registration_notes: Official site was unreachable during research; 2027 date and race data from ITRA listings.
events.summary: Mountain ultra around Bhandardara in the Sahyadris that climbs Kalsubai (1,646 m), Maharashtra's highest peak, and passes five forts. Distances from a 15K and a vertical kilometre up to 115K.

categories.name: 35K
categories.notes: About 1,506 m gain; starts and finishes at Waki Dam.

categories.name: 55K
categories.notes: About 2,146 m gain.

categories.name: 115K
categories.notes: Field of about 150; 9 aid stations.

course.surface: mountain trails with iron ladders on steep sections
course.description: Sahyadri trails near Bhandardara Dam over Kalsubai and the Alang-Madan-Kulang forts.

tips: Bhandardara is about 165 km (4 hours) by road from Mumbai and closer from Nashik.
Steep ladder sections need hands-free kit; use a vest rather than handheld bottles.
Late January nights in the hills are cold; the 115K starts at 12:30 AM.

events.name: Anjur Ascent Ultra
events.venue: Arulmigu Sri Veera Aanchaneyar Temple, Kunnavakkam (near Anjur)
events.registration_notes: Timed hill-loop formats are selected by review, not first come first served.
events.summary: Hill trail ultra south of Chennai mixing distance races with 6- and 12-hour hill-loop challenges on a 2.2 km, 150 m climb loop.

categories.name: 6 Hours Hill Loop
categories.eligibility: In the last year: 700 m+ trail race (25 km in 5 h, 30 km in 6 h or 35 km in 7 h) or a road marathon under 5:00
categories.notes: About 25 km and 1,800 m gain. Morning or 12:00 PM window, 30 slots.

categories.name: 12 Hours Hill Loop
categories.eligibility: In the last year: a trail or endurance ultra over 42 km, or a 50 km trail with 1,500 m+ in 10 hours
categories.notes: About 50 km and 3,600 m gain. 20 slots. Two loops must be finished within each hour.

course.surface: forest paths, rocky sections and technical climbs
course.description: Multi-terrain hill course with steep ascents; timed formats repeat a 2.2 km loop with about 150 m gain.

tips: For the timed formats you must finish two loops inside each hour; practise short, steep hill repeats.
Mid-February is the coolest part of the Chennai year, but rock heats up fast after 10 AM.

events.name: OOTYULTRA
events.registration_notes: No official site found. Date from race listings; last edition date from a third-party calendar.
events.summary: Road ultramarathon on the steep hill roads of the Nilgiris around Ooty, organised by KaysFIT Academy, with distances from 15K to 90K. Supported by the Tea Board of India.

categories.name: 75K
categories.notes: Listed by one source only.

course.description: Demanding road course with long, steep climbs and descents around Ooty.

highlights: High-altitude road ultra in the Nilgiris
tips: Ooty sits above 2,000 m; March mornings are cold and the thin air slows climbing.
Coimbatore airport is the usual gateway; allow about 3 hours for the ghat drive up.
Practise long downhill running to protect quads on the steep descents.

events.name: Western Ghats Ultra Marathon
events.registration_notes: Prices include state taxes; amounts not published.
events.summary: Midnight road ultra through the Tamhini and Mulshi dam area west of Pune, with distances in miles from 5 to 35. Pitched as a Comrades training run.

categories.name: 5 Miles
categories.notes: +140 m. 2026 timings.

categories.name: 35 Miles
categories.notes: +650 m. No intermediate cutoffs.

course.description: Dark, winding roads beside the Tamhini Wildlife Sanctuary and Mulshi Dam; elevation is for the 35-mile route.

tips: Races start between midnight and 12:20 AM; carry a headlamp and reflective gear.
Semi-supported: carry at least 1 L of water.
Maale is on the Pune-Mulshi road; arrange transport as there is little public transport at night.

events.name: Sinhagad Epic Trail
events.registration_notes: Prices include Maharashtra state taxes; amounts not published.
events.summary: Monsoon-season mountain trail race on the slopes of Sinhagad Fort near Pune, from an 11K climb to a 42K with 2,200 m of gain. ITRA points for 21K and longer.

categories.name: 11K
categories.notes: +790 m, max altitude 1,296 m. 2026 timings.

categories.name: 21K
categories.notes: Actual distance 22 km, +1230 m.

categories.name: 30K
categories.notes: +1560 m. Cutoff at 23 km by 11:30 AM.

categories.name: 42K
categories.notes: +2200 m. Cutoffs at 23 km (11:30 AM) and 30.5 km (1:30 PM).

course.surface: steep rocky and muddy hill trails
course.description: Repeated climbs on Sinhagad's slopes between about 650 m and 1,296 m altitude; elevation figure is for the 42K.

tips: Late June is early monsoon in the Sahyadris: expect rain, slick rock and mud; use shoes with aggressive lugs.
Aatkarwadi is on the Pune side of Sinhagad; park early as the access road is narrow.
Finish times here count toward SRT Ultra eligibility.

events.name: Chennai Trail Ultra
events.venue: Dr. Ambedkar Football Ground, Erumaivettipalayam, North Chennai
events.registration_notes: 2026 registration opened 6 Jun 2026; fees not published.
events.summary: ITRA-listed low-elevation trail race on the northern edge of Chennai, held on the first Sunday of September (2024-2026). Course mixes dam bunds, cashew orchards, gullies and sandy riverbeds.

categories.name: 50K
categories.notes: Veterans 51+ get 8:00. Torch mandatory.

categories.name: 32.2K
categories.notes: Women 6:00, veteran men 6:00, veteran women 6:30. Torch mandatory.

categories.name: 16.1K
categories.notes: Women 3:15. Wave starts 15 minutes apart.

course.surface: dam bunds, orchard tracks, loose red soil gullies and sandy riverbeds
course.description: Low-elevation trail loop on the city's northern fringe; about 190-239 m gain for the 50K per race guide.

tips: Soft sand near paddy fields and riverbeds is the main challenge; gaiters help.
September mornings are hot and humid; the 4:30 AM 50K start avoids the worst heat.
Carry a torch for the 50K and 32.2K pre-dawn starts.
